name: Merit
tagline: A Friday desk that scores civic, science and fringe claims on a rubric
description: Once a week it sweeps a wide territory - civic claims, science, UAP and the paranormal - and puts each one through a scoring rubric instead of a vibe check. A running list of unresolved claims carries forward, and the whole thing lands as a single weekly brief for readers who would rather verify than believe.
author: ChiChi077
